reason: Full-size_t row count replaces signed32 truncation; NEON ceil uses overflow-free integer quotient/remainder and full size_t batches. Bounded inner batch remains signed int so final subtraction by7 may become negative instead of unsigned underflow. Unsigned output accumulation already has defined modulo32 semantics; no signed-output overflow repair is claimed for QU8. NEON guarded do-while normalized to while with byte-identical body and no jumps. QCP record SIGSEGV was reproduced in the signed neighboring case; this unsigned control normalization is justified by the same generic checked bridge, not claimed as an unsigned semantic counterexample.
rows_domain: All positive uint64 row counts and all uint64 strides under the existing public rd_inputs/rd_mem valid non-wrapping row-footprint contract; stride0 and overlapping input/zero rows are preserved. Numeric address-wrap layouts are outside this contract. Initialized output is separate from the owned readonly footprint, as already expressed by public separation conjunction.
domain_clarification: Documentation only; no Require, C body, annotation, mathematical model or parameter domain was changed.
